text:
I fixed the type error in `src/index.ts`. `label` is declared as a `string` but was assigned the number `8417`, so I changed the value to the string `"8417"`. `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit` now passes.

`node_modules` didn't exist, so I ran `npm install --no-save typescript` to get `tsc` to run. That left a `node_modules` directory in the project, but `package.json` is unchanged.

If `label` should be a number, change its type to `number` and keep the original value.
